notes:
Stage: procurement — SLA negotiation focused. Customer is migrating 3 core workloads (chat ops for bridge crews, fleet-diagnostics embeddings, and mission-critical reranking for incident logs). Redwood proposed Dedicated + Private control plane. Harbormark flagged uptime and credits as the primary blocker; legal insists on 99.95% or higher and stronger credit schedule than standard.

Key quotes: "We can’t have 15+ minutes of downtime during peak harbor operations — that’s unacceptable." — Head of Ops.

Negotiation points in play: uptime percentage, credit calculation (sliding scale by minutes outside SLO), maintenance windows (preferred 0200-0500 local; will accept monthly 1-hour windows if notified 30 days ahead), support SLAs (P1 30m response, 2h initial mitigation; P2 2h response; P3 next-business-day), reserved GPU sizing and burst policy, throughput guarantees (baseline and peak), data residency requirements for AIS/manifest payloads.

Technical asks from SE: provide validated throughput profile for their 12-A100 equivalent reserve with expected workloads (512-token avg chat + 1k-token rerank), include p95 latency numbers and tail behavior during burst. Harbormark requested a short capacity run (2 days production-sim) to validate p95 latency ≤220ms for 512-token chat responses and sustained throughput of ~250 QPS at peak.

Commercial asks from Procurement: Net-30 invoice terms, breakouts for reserved vs overage usage, clear credit formula (minutes outside SLO -> % credit of monthly fee). Legal proposed additional clause: maintenance not to exceed 4 hours/month without replacement credits, and emergency maintenance only with 4-hour SLA notice where possible. Redwood countered with typical 99.9% + scheduled maintenance windows; open to tweak credit schedule for enterprise booking.

Action items: AE to circulate redlined SLA (redwood/legal + harbormark/legal) by 2024-12-20. SE to deliver capacity run plan and performance profile by 2024-12-22. CSM to prepare onboarding checklist and runbook for incident escalation. Procurement to confirm billing terms this week.

CRM shorthand: urgent legal asks, POC agreed (2-day sim), need explicit credit table, confirm maintenance window alignment with global port ops.
